name: Conversion of Reccared
summary: Visigothic King Reccared I converts from Arianism to Catholic Christianity at the Third Council of Toledo (589), the most significant moment in Visigothic history. The conversion ends the religious divide between the Arian Germanic ruling class and the Catholic Hispano-Roman majority. The Church's administrative capacity and ideological support transformed the Visigothic kingdom's governance. All subsequent Spanish Christianity draws from this moment; Spain's eventual identification of Catholicism with national identity begins here.

_quarry.structural_significance: Unifies the Visigothic Kingdom under a single religion; enables the Church-monarchy alliance that shapes Iberian history; creates the conditions for the Reconquista ideology
